results.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'Brazil'

results.question: How many shipped orders are there?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipped_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

results.question: What is the price of the Coffee Maker?
results.generated_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Coffee Maker'

results.question: List the product names in the Books category that cost less than 20 dollars.
results.generated_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Books' AND price < 20

results.question: What is the average price of Home products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Home'

results.question: How many customers have placed more than 4 orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 4)

results.question: What is the highest product price in each category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT category, MAX(price) AS max_price FROM products GROUP BY category

results.question: How many orders contain more than 2 line items?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(order_item_id) > 2)

results.question: How many orders were placed by customers from Australia?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.country = 'Australia'

results.question: How many units of Desk Lamp have been sold?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items WHERE product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Desk Lamp')

results.question: What is the revenue from Sports products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id WHERE products.category = 'Sports'

results.question: What is the average order value for shipped orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(total_order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM ( SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_order_value FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'shipped' ) subquery

results.question: How many orders did customers from the USA place in 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.country = 'USA' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_date) = 2024

results.question: What is the total quantity sold for each product category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

results.question: How many orders were placed in December 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 12;

results.question: How many customers signed up in the first half of 2023?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2023 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM signup_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6

results.question: What was the revenue in 2025?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_date) = 2025 AND orders.status = 'completed'

results.question: How many orders were placed on or after 2025-01-01?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01'
